notes: The bench judge's expected-verdict roster (tools/benchjudge --roster): membership by cell name, the board-side sibling of the gate's expected-failure test roster. Every cell is judged at the ceiling its bench sidecar declares (general 1.3, text 1.7; tools/benchjudge states both derivations) — this file carries expectations only and can never select a ceiling. `red` cells must be judged and read red at their own ceiling: the permanent schoolbook display tripwire (`display_schoolbook/hugeleaf`, a text-ceiling cell timing the known-quadratic conversion class kept in bench code — green means the tripwire went dark), and the hugeleaf display pair (`version_display/hugeleaf`, `clock_display/hugeleaf`: general-class cells whose hugeleaf-width rendering is conversion-dominated, measured e 1.39/1.42 at the 1.3 ceiling, quick sampling 2026-07-27 — owned by the text column; whether the cure is a faster render or a text-class migration is the open class question). Every other cell, the pinned subset's designed diagonal and the BOARD_DECLARED_BENCH_RIDERS alike, must fit under its own ceiling: the board's declared-model cells (the tick trio's and min_ticks' certificate/reign heap constants, the mirror-wide display pair's limb model) keep their time legs judged green — a declared counter model is not a time-exponent red (the pre-census riders measured e 0.93–1.18, 2026-07-27; the 2026-07-28 census re-realization swapped the cured display riders for the ticks-landing min_ticks cells, judge verification at the next bench-judge run). `boundary` cells fit within the fit-noise band of their own ceiling (fit_noise_band in tools/benchjudge states the derivation) and may read either verdict; the set is empty at this tip. The sampling pin lists both modes because these are exponent-class expectations, which hold under quick and record sampling alike (record-mode wide-pair exponents measured 1.464/2.001, 2026-07-24); the profile and the scale pair stay singly pinned. Membership is pinned by crates/before/tests/bench_judge_roster.rs.
